steps.caption: Open Today at the top of the sidebar.
The date, and a one-line summary: meetings, follow-ups due, new signals, lease alerts and approvals.
‹ and › move to yesterday or tomorrow; 'Today' brings you back.
Getting started: a checklist for new workspaces. It disappears once everything is done.
Today's schedule: every meeting with its time, place and whether its brief is ready.
Priority tasks and follow-ups: due today or overdue. Tick the box to mark one done.
Mark the first task done.
Overdue commitments: promises made to clients that are past their date.
Meetings needing prep: what is still missing before each meeting.
Recommended next actions, numbered in order. Each says why — overdue promise, missing prep, a deal gone quiet.
Right-hand side: Capacity — minutes in meetings, free time and your working day.
Pending approvals, new signals, lease alerts, deals needing attention and priority accounts follow.
Each section links to the full list — e.g. All signals, Leases, Deals.
The plan is built by itself at 08:00. To see it in Automation, open More → Automation → Daily plan.
Build now rebuilds today's plan from the latest data; Open planner goes back to Today.
Press Build now. The rebuild is queued and the plan appears here within a few minutes.
Capacity warnings flag clashes: overlapping meetings, too many meetings, overdue promises, an overbooked day.
Suggestions are only suggestions: you decide what to move. Nothing is rescheduled for you.
Now the Weekly review tab.
Built every Friday at 18:00: new opportunities, priority account changes, signals and meetings of the week.
Further down: overdue commitments, changed requirements and active deals — a checklist for next week.
